purpose: Parallel source-backed price-strategy tournament under conservative execution costs. This protocol is separate from and does not modify the pre-registered strategy-tournament-v1 order-flow/regime protocol.

data.source: Binance USD-M public futures klines for historical development breadth
data.cross_exchange_warning: Binance historical development evidence is not MEXC untouched OOS evidence. Any candidate must transfer unchanged to MEXC paper/shadow data.

dependence_and_trials.trial_unit: family x interval x parameter variant x round-trip cost case; calendar time fold is the dependence cluster and symbols are aggregated inside each fold

interpretation.12: maker-fee floor proxy before adverse selection/slippage
interpretation.16: taker-fee floor proxy before adverse selection/slippage
interpretation.20: taker plus additional friction stress case

mexc_api_fee_reference.source: MEXC announcement: Updates to API Futures Trading Fees (Jun 1, 2026)

donchian_breakout.market_state_hypothesis: range breakout predicts continuation during directional states

ema_tsmom.market_state_hypothesis: EMA separation normalized by ATR identifies persistent directional state

bb_mean_reversion.market_state_hypothesis: extreme Bollinger displacement plus RSI exhaustion identifies reversion-prone state

bb_squeeze_breakout.market_state_hypothesis: low bandwidth followed by band breakout identifies volatility expansion with directional continuation

intraday_reversal.market_state_hypothesis: large standardized short-horizon moves can overreact and mean-revert

trend_pullback.market_state_hypothesis: pullbacks inside an established EMA trend can resume in trend direction

vol_scaled_momentum.market_state_hypothesis: return normalized by realized volatility identifies directional persistence while reducing noisy weak signals

forward_rule.selection: Only candidates that pass development screening and adversarial review may be frozen.
forward_rule.forward_source: MEXC public market data / paper-shadow path after freeze
